original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: A caged signal flame rises from an iron tripod between hinged ember mirrors and a heavy oath chain.
An oval hide drum hangs between forked blackwood stilts with jawbone clappers and reed charms.
An offset crystal lens and ray vanes pivot above an ivory and bronze relay stand.
Two sap-lit living roots form a grafted arch hung with seed baskets, pruning hooks, and a leaf bell.
A riveted pressure column carries mismatched gauges, copper pipes, a flywheel, and gear offering trays.
A salt-black ship-rib mast leans over a cracked fog bell, cold lanterns, shell markers, and ballast stones.
The Toll Chain Court with its heavy chain lowered and coiled beside the winch, leaving the cobbled road fully clear.
The Root Lease Gate with its woven barrier withdrawn, its living arch open, and a renewed green-gold lease ribbon tied at the side.
The repaired Pressure Rail Stop with a safe gauge reading, lifted stop hardware, glowing brass indicator, and unobstructed rails.
The raised Campaign Muster Seal glowing warm gold between fully unfurled blue banners, with a fresh wax charter seal on its dais.
The still-broken Accord Marker formally recorded with a bronze central band, neatly retied red cords, and calm amber witness light.
The sworn Witness Stone with its carved eye shining pale gold-blue above two lit candles and a small blue oath ribbon.
Warm windows, grain stores, and a raised civic pennant mark the secured Granary Lock Exchange.
Violet altar light and green marsh lanterns mark the secured Blackwater Shrine Marker.
A cyan-gold prism flare and straight banners mark the secured Prism Yard Standard.
Gold fracture light and witness seals show the Broken Treaty Stone has been recorded.
An engaged handle and green lock light show the Sealed Causeway Lever has released.
A calm cyan reflection and lit calibration marks show the Mirror Anchor Frame aligned.
A repaired raised banner and warm lanterns show the Crownless Standard has been claimed.
A restored rope, teal-gold light, and fresh ripples show the Drowned Toll Bell has rung.
A bright wax seal, open ribbon, and green leaves show the Orchard Writ has been accepted.
An engaged wheel, taut chains, and amber hub show the Brass Oath Wheel has been secured.
A repaired bowl and strong signal flame show the Burned Signal Brazier has been restored.
Fresh planks, taut ropes, lit lamps, and a blue pennant show the ferry stage is claimed.
A working hoist, loaded basket, new braces, and lantern show the quarry head is claimed.
Fresh leaves, teal sap-light, and living buds show the Withered Rootgate has been restored.
An open stone door, broken seal, empty coffer, and survey lantern show the Barrow Vault has been claimed.
An open bronze gate, emptied reliquary, calm water, and recovery lamps show the Drowned Reliquary is secured.
Open doors, aligned lamps, a bright crown lantern, and teal floor seal show the Lantern Crown Nave is consecrated.
Breached reed towers, fading smoke, a cleared stair, and salvage lamps show the Hive of Reeds has been reclaimed.
Calm cyan crystals, repaired access, amber lamps, and survey pennants show the Glassbound Eyrie is secured.
A cooled furnace, open vents, slack chains, and teal inspection lamps show the Rust Choir Foundry is silenced.
Open wagon covers, orderly salvage, warm lamps, and a clear center lane show the Salt-Wight Convoy route is open.
An open gate, removed hostile banner, controlled roots, fresh shoots, and ward lamps show the Rootwarden Stockade reclaimed.
A blackened iron crossbar raises three separate rain-charred charter plates above a sealed ember bowl, with off-center chain tags making the Embercourt oath readable by silhouette.
Three crooked reed hooks surround a stretched hide oath drum on root feet, with dangling peatwax tokens creating a broad low Mireclaw silhouette.
Three triangular mirror vanes climb a slim sunstone mast around a bright central prism, making a precise ascending Sunvault survey silhouette.
A living forked trunk cradles three luminous seed pods at unequal heights, with thorn ties and root feet forming an organic Thornwake border mark.
A riveted pressure crossbar carries three unequal furnace gauges, hanging counterweights, and a compact black bell in a heavy Brasshollow silhouette.
A pale crescent ship-rib mast suspends three tide bells above salt-dark chains and a narrow wakeglass marker in a haunting Veilmourn silhouette.
